raw_case_text: A 54-year-old male experienced blurred vision in the right eye 2 months after HAART initiation (Zidovudine [AZT], Lamivudine [3TC], and Efavirenz [EFV]). CD4 counts were 200/mul. Visual Acuity (VA) was 20/166 in the right eye. Ophthalmic examination showed retinal necrosis and hemorrhages with severe vitritis (+++) in zones 2 and 3. OCT showed a slight epiretinal membrane in the macular of the right eye. He underwent PPV and silicone oil tamponades, and silicone oil removal was conducted 6 months later. Vitreous DNA sequencing showed CMV sequence of 66,544 copies. A total of 10 intravitreal injections were performed until the lesions were stable. His VA of the right eye was 20/100 at the last follow-up.

subjective.chief_complaint: A 54-year-old male presenting with blurred vision in the right eye for two months following antiretroviral therapy initiation.
subjective.history_of_present_illness: The patient presented with progressive painless visual blurring involving the right eye that began two months after commencing highly active antiretroviral therapy. His visual acuity progressively decreased, prompting ophthalmologic evaluation.
subjective.past_medical_history: Receiving combination antiretroviral therapy consisting of zidovudine (AZT), lamivudine (3TC), and efavirenz (EFV) initiated two months prior.
subjective.review_of_systems: Blurred vision in the right eye; denies eye pain, ocular discharge, headache, or systemic fever.

objective.physical_examination: Ophthalmic Examination: Visual acuity (VA) in the right eye was 20/166; fundoscopic examination revealed retinal necrosis and hemorrhages with severe vitritis (+++) located in zones 2 and 3.
objective.advanced_workup: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) of the right macula: Mild epiretinal membrane. Vitreous fluid sampled for metagenomic DNA sequencing.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation: Definitive diagnosis: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis and immune recovery vitritis (IRV) of the right eye in a patient with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection on HAART (CD4+ T-cell count 200/microL). Diagnostic confirmation: High-copy cytomegalovirus DNA (66,544 copies) detected by vitreous DNA sequencing, along with pathognomonic retinal necrosis, hemorrhage, and severe vitreous inflammation. Plan & Outcome: Underwent pars plana vitrectomy (PPV) with silicone oil tamponade, followed by a total of 10 intravitreal antiviral injections until retinal lesions stabilized. Silicone oil removal was performed 6 months later. Final visual acuity in the right eye improved to 20/100 at last follow-up.
